ability.name: magic_item_survival
ability.effect: Each +1 grants a 10% probability of surviving contact unscathed.

diet.rule: Feeds upon the rust it creates.

procedure.name: magic_item_rusting
procedure.condition: A magic metal item contacts the rust monster's antennae or hide.

steps.step: Check whether the item survives unscathed, using a 10% chance per plus.
If it does not survive unscathed, reduce its magical bonus by 1.
Repeat on subsequent contacts until the item becomes ordinary.
Once ordinary, any later contact rusts it into uselessness.

procedure.outcome: Magic metal items degrade one bonus at a time before becoming useless.

confidence_notes.note: The heading is absent in the source chunk; the entry name was inferred from the prose beginning "Pegasi are..." and the stat block immediately following Owl Bear.
The dungeon and wilderness encounter lines are merged in the source. I interpreted both as Clowder (1d4) outside lair and Den (1d4) in lair.
The stat block prints "2 (tentacles)" while the prose describes two barbed shoulder whips. I preserved the printed stat block and noted the prose wording.
The source prints "d8/1d8/2d10". I normalized the first talon damage to 1d8 as obvious markup corruption.

The dungeon and wilderness encounter rows are merged in the source. I interpreted Flame Salamander as Band (1d4+1) / Nest (2d4) in dungeons and Swarm (2d4) / Nest (2d4) in wilderness, and Frost Salamander as Band (1d3) / Nest (1d3) in both environments.
